**New York State – Prohibited Invasive Plants (DEC, 2020 update)**  

The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation publishes a single table of all plant species that are *“Prohibited”* (no sale, possession, or planting is allowed).  The list is found in the PDF file **“isprohibitedplants2.pdf”** (retrieved 2024‑09‑14) and contains 69 species, grouped by growth habit (terrestrial, wetland, aquatic).  Regulated species that are legal to sell/possess are listed elsewhere but are **not** part of this answer.
